platform: IndieXL Official New Single 320kbps MP3 Upload Form Route
manual_review_reason: IndieXL accepts only new/current singles that fit its indie and alternative format, explicitly excludes Hip Hop, Rap, House, EDM, Pop, R&B and Urban, and requires an actual tagged 320-kbps MP3 named Artist – Title.mp3 with a maximum size of 12 MB. A human must confirm that the selected MarcsMusic track genuinely fits the station format, verify metadata and file size, approve the upload fields and submit the file manually.

platform: KANM Student Radio Official Artist Submission Google Form Route
manual_review_reason: KANM explicitly directs artists to an external Google Form for music review. The form target could not be safely inspected through the crawler, so its live fields, session state, upload or link requirements, consent language and any runtime verification controls remain unknown. A human must open the authorized form normally, review every requirement and submit manually without using the public Music Director email as a workaround.

platform: KZUU 90.7 FM Official Music-by-Mail and Band Contact Route
manual_review_reason: KZUU says sending music by mail is generally the fastest way to reach the station and publishes a public General Manager address for telling the station about an artist or managed band. It does not publish complete accepted-media, file, metadata, clean-edit, return or release-window rules. A human must choose either a concise information inquiry or the physical route, confirm the current package requirements and avoid duplicate delivery.

platform: KWVA 88.1 FM Official Demo and Music Donation Physical Route
manual_review_reason: KWVA directs band demos and music donations to its Music Director mailing address. Its public music@kwvaradio.org address is specifically presented for discussing an interview, not as permission to deliver digital music. A human must confirm the accepted physical format, prepare the demo or donation package, review metadata and clean/explicit notes, and mail it manually; any interview inquiry must remain separate and asset-free unless requested.

platform: KCOU 88.1 FM Official New-Submitter Music Director and Physical Review Route
manual_review_reason: KCOU tells labels, promoters and independent artists with no prior station relationship to call or email the Music Director for instructions before beginning record service or providing submissions. Its policy then asks for radio-friendly, airable-quality recordings with band contact information and recommends a media kit, while giving no airplay guarantee. A human must make an asset-free routing inquiry first, confirm the accepted delivery format, review profanity or clean-edit status and prepare any physical package manually.
